name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) for protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) governing a customer's subscription to and use of a provider's cloud-hosted product.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback during development.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining uptime and support response time commitments and remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) governing statements of work for services and deliverables performed for a customer.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) governing a provider's processing of a customer's personal data, including international transfer terms.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement governing an on-premises or installed license to use a provider's software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement governing business partnerships, including cooperation obligations and trademark licensing between the parties.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for giving a prospective customer time-limited access to evaluate a product before entering a definitive agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing a business associate's use and protection of protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum supplementing an underlying agreement with terms governing use of AI Services, model training, and ownership of AI inputs and outputs.
